title: Mirroring and handedness must stay explicit
plainLanguage: Flipping a picture can be useful, but the character’s left arm is still the left arm. A mirrored drawing is not automatically a valid opposite-side piece.
purpose: Prevent side confusion and invalid shortcuts as the part library grows.

rules.statement: Never silently swap anatomical left/right when mirroring.
Record whether a part is approved for mirror reuse, requires an opposite-side variant, or is untested.
Similarity search may show explicit mirrored candidates, but must label them as mirrored candidates.
Preserve the doll rig’s explicit mirror transform behavior separately from anatomical identity.

implementation.currentSupport: Anatomical side convention and doll flipX behavior already exist separately.
implementation.futureWork: Add explicit mirrorability to poser-part records and search UI.
